repos.name: InkNote
repos.description: InkNote is a handwriting notebook that lives entirely in your browser. Write on a tablet with a stylus and real pen dynamics — four nibs with pressure- and speed-shaped strokes — annotate PDFs, give every page the paper it should have (A6 to Tabloid, portrait or landscape, any colour or template), export  them — as a PNG, a PDF, or one backup file.
